$comment: Every third-party package the workspace may depend on, with the reason. Production and dev lists are separate: a package approved for development only fails if it appears in dependencies. Internal @strategos/* workspace packages are always allowed. Checked by scripts/check-dependencies.mjs in `pnpm test` and in CI before deploy (Production Rules: no AI/LLM, no telemetry, no network services).

dependencies.dexie: IndexedDB wrapper for on-device, namespaced learner storage (no network).
dependencies.react-router-dom: Client-side routing (HashRouter) for the static PWA.

devDependencies.@testing-library/user-event: Simulated user input in component tests.
devDependencies.@types/node: Node type definitions for tests and build scripts.
devDependencies.fake-indexeddb: In-memory IndexedDB for storage unit tests.
devDependencies.playwright: Browser automation for e2e and screenshot scripts.
devDependencies.vite-plugin-pwa: Service worker and web manifest generation (build only).
